t: Stefan Dušan was crowned Emperor of the Serbs and Greeks in Skopje on 16 April 1346, a title that claimed the succession of the Byzantine Empire.
Dušan's Code, enacted in 1349 and 1354, had 201 articles based on Roman-Byzantine law and is considered a medieval constitution.
Under Stefan Uroš V the empire fragmented into principalities, and it effectively ended with his death in 1371, the year of the Battle of Maritsa.
dyk: Stefan Dušan did not fight a single field battle to win his empire: he took it by besieging cities.
ev: Dušan attacks the Byzantine Empire and takes Ohrid, Prilep and Kastoria
At Serres Dušan proclaims himself Tsar
In Skopje Dušan is crowned Emperor of the Serbs and Greeks, and the Serbian Archbishopric becomes a Patriarchate
The first assembly at Skopje enacts Dušan's Code
Dušan invades Hum and occupies part of the land disputed with the Bosnian Ban Stephen II Kotromanić
A second assembly at Serres completes Dušan's Code
Dušan dies of an unknown illness and is succeeded by Stefan Uroš V
The Ottomans defeat Vukašin at the Battle of Maritsa; Uroš V dies childless on 4 December

f.successor: Moravian Serbia and other semi-independent lordships, later Ottoman rule
